crossRefs.note: Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don’t forget, and don’t deviate from the words of my mouth.
Tell wisdom, “You are my sister.” Call understanding your relative,
You simple, understand prudence! You fools, be of an understanding heart!
How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes, to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.
Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?
Behold, I have taught you statutes and ordinances, even as Yahweh my God commanded me, that you should do so in the…
Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the peoples who shall hear…
Give your servant therefore an understanding heart to judge your people, that I may discern between good and evil; for…
From infancy, you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith, which is…
